notes.title: Update Notes for Patch 3
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fix for softlock that can occur when clicking super fast in the shop collection area
[*]You can now bind grab / drop separately rather than it being a combined input.
[*]Grab and Drop tutorial in Meat level now is 2 different steps
[*]Completing the [spoiler]True Ending[/spoiler] now records your best time for that level.
[*]Fixed Basketball and Stability Orb having incorrect hover strings.
[*]Towed items will no longer drop and become disconnected while using the Shop.
[*][spoiler]Crystal Skull now displayed on main menu when completed for each level.[/spoiler]
[/list]

Big thank you to everyone who has been reporting bugs, it is super helpful!
- Luke

notes.title: Update Notes for Patch 2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Switch controller support.
[*]New control system for Deep Dive 2. It is MUCH easier to control now!
[*]32:9 ultra widescreen support.
[*]Fix for submarine and tunnel interaction.
[*][Mac] Fix for multitasking / task switching crashing the game. Let me know if you see any visual artifacts from this change, as it required vSync when on Mac to be turned off.
[*]Maximum depth line now does not show if you have the Iron Lung perk.
[*]Can speed up opening sequence by holding shift (or whatever you have sprint mapped to on your controller).
[*]Fix for grab/drop marker appearing incorrectly when using a terminal, in the submarine and more.
[*]Found and fixed some inconsistent collision rules on the bombs. In particular, it makes dislodging loot from walls, and chain reaction / diver damage much more consistent and visually accurate!
[*]Can no longer click on the buttons on Expedition Over screen before they have appeared.
[*]Fixed screen being stuck red when taking bomb damage during enemy attack.
[*]DPad working for Hatch Control console.
[*]New string for Mini Chest that correctly specifies you need an extra key.
[*]Fix for Guideline not loading correctly in some states.
[*]Minor translation improvements.
[/list]

Big thank you to everyone who has been reporting bugs, it is super helpful!
- Luke

notes.title: Update Notes for Patch 1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Confirmation warning when you press Restart in the pause menu.
[*]Fix to credits screen showing incorrectly.

[/list]

Big thank you to everyone who has been reporting bugs, it is super helpful!
- Luke

notes.title: [New Trailer] Feed the Deep is coming out on August 16th!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Luke here! I’ve got some exciting news: I can now reveal the release date for Feed the Deep! August 16th!

As mentioned before, it’s coming out for PC and Mac. I’d love to know what you think of the new trailer. It’s surreal to see this thing I’ve been working on day in and out for the last few months look so official. It feels so close yet so far haha, I’m excited to get it in your hands.
So here it is, the official release date announcement trailer. I hope you enjoy :)

Thank you for all the support!

notes.title: Demo Patch!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for all the amazing feedback and detailed bug reports so far! I haven't managed to get everything in, but this patch should address a bunch of issues and bring some neat new things to mess around with.

[list]
[*] New shop item: Mystery chest (replaces the Perk Sphere)
[*] Heaps of new things that you can possibly find in the Mystery chest.
[*] Fixed infinite air exploit.
[*] Fixed multiple speed lines stopping the player from getting their speed bonus.
[*] New gem loot that can be sometime found.
[*] Chests now only require one tow line instead of two.
[*] Nerfed the silt blindness a TINY BIT to make it less punishing.
[*] New enemy scream sound that is still scary but not quite as “nails on a chalkboard”.
[*] Fixed water background tiling issue.
[*] Emergency teleport now has a screen effect and sound.
[*] Fixed being able to click on items while reading a journal.
[*] Fixed buttons being able to be shrunk into oblivion by rapidly clicking.
[*] New “Damage Effects” setting toggle that turns off any blood effects. (For now it just turns them off, but later it will be replaced with another suitable effect).
[*] New shiny effect when depositing to the shop.
[*] Fixed bug where items being deposited in the shop can apparently launch stuff into the terrain to be lost forever!
[*] Few small localisation tweaks (if you have more, please em coming!)
[*] [b]EXPERIMENTAL[/b]: DPAD LEFT/RIGHT to cycle through the items you are currently towing. This should make it easier to drop / use specific items for gamepad users. There is no in-game prompts for this yet however!
[/list]
<3 Luke
